{{Hatnote|For other irregular sizes, see [[Oversized and undersized cards]]}}
'''Oversized Boba Fett sticker (Scrye 5.2)''' is the June 1998 ''[[Scrye]]'' 5.2 magazine insert of an oversized [[Boba Fett]] sticker. The issue also packed a [[Jabba's Palace Limited|Jabba's Palace]] rules supplement, card checklist, and player's guide.<ref name="enc183">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf#page=183 SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 183–184 (Magazine Coverage). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261009141805/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive]</ref><ref name="enc20mag">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/SWCCG+Collecting+Encyclopedia+2.0.pdf#page=50 SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 2.0], pp. 50–52 (Magazine Promotions). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261024031553/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/SWCCG+Collecting+Encyclopedia+2.0.pdf Internet Archive]</ref>

The cover is Jabba and Leia art.<ref name="enc183" />
